piles.label: More than one deck
piles.intro: Cards suggested for more than one deck. Copies are shared in Arena, so one card can sit in every deck it fits.

piles.label: Fits none
piles.intro: Pack cards that were checked against a matching deck and skipped, each with the reason. Listed so nothing is silently dropped.

Pinnacle Emissary.text: 26 Iron Colossi: ROLE-PLAYER — A Robot artifact creature that makes a 1/1 flying Drone for every artifact spell you cast; warp {U/R} for an early trigger. Cut: Cosmic Cube. | 48 Doombots: SIDEGRADE — As in 26: a Robot that turns artifact spells into flying Drones. Cut: UNOWNED: Mm'menon, Uthros Exile (an artifact-enters payoff; Leyline makes either a Robot).

Bat'leth.text: UPGRADE — Equipment with removal: on entering, an opponent's creature gets -2/-2; then +2/+0. Orzhov Equipment, Standard-legal. Cut: Shrike Force.

Combadge.text: 38 Armory: ROLE-PLAYER — Equipment that copies itself when cast (two for 3); a creature wearing one can't be blocked while another wears the other. Equip {2}. Cut: Shrike Force. | 74 Iron Hills Forge: ROLE-PLAYER — Two Equipment for 3 (it copies itself), so two bodies of equip-trigger fodder; equip {2}. Cut: owned deck: confirm with `cuts 74`.

L'Rell, Fierce Visionary.text: ROLE-PLAYER — A hasty 2/1 Klingon token at every combat (sacrificed at end step), plus a sacrifice outlet that surveils. Cut: owned deck: confirm with `cuts 55`.

Craterous Stomp.text: SIDEGRADE — Instant: 3 damage to an opponent's creature; their other creatures can't block Giants or Warriors that turn. Cut: UNOWNED: Mishra's Command (X-cost modal sorcery).

Forging the Tyrite Sword.text: SIDEGRADE — Two Treasures, then chapter III tutors any Equipment (Embercleave, Kaldra) to hand. Cut: UNOWNED: Stoneforge Mystic (also an Equipment tutor; it also cheats one in).

Meteoric Mace.text: SPICE — Cascade on cast plus +4/+0 and trample; much weaker than Embercleave, but owned. Cut: UNOWNED: Embercleave (a stand-in until it is crafted).

Spectral Steel.text: ROLE-PLAYER — +2/+2 Aura that later returns an Aura or Equipment from the graveyard to hand. Cut: UNOWNED: Shadowspear (a stand-in; much weaker).

Storm-Kiln Artist.text: SIDEGRADE — A Treasure for every instant you cast on your own creature; +1/+0 per artifact. Cut: UNOWNED: Erratic Cyclops (also rewards casting instants).

Stormforged Armor.text: SPICE — Equip by paying 3 life; the creature conjures an attacking Ball Lightning on every attack. Cut: UNOWNED: Kaldra Compleat (a stand-in until it is crafted).

Elvish Elegy.text: ROLE-PLAYER — {B/G}: mill three, permanent +1/+1 to graveyard creatures, an Elf or land to hand. Cut: Leyline of Transformation.

Perennial Gravewarden.text: ROLE-PLAYER — 2-mana Elf that returns from the graveyard on a turn a creature entered and one died. Cut: Leyline of Transformation.

Concert Kaboomist.text: FLAVOUR — Damage to an opponent equal to noncreature spells cast since your last turn. Cut: Torbran.

Fiery Inscription.text: FLAVOUR — 2 damage to each opponent per instant or sorcery you cast; worth it only with a high spell count. Cut: Torbran.

Ghitu Journeymage.text: ROLE-PLAYER — 2 damage to each opponent on entering if you control another Wizard; deck runs 7 Wizards. Cut: Torbran.

Soul-Scar Mage.text: ROLE-PLAYER — Prowess; your noncombat damage to their creatures becomes -1/-1 counters. Cut: Torbran.

Unstable Amulet.text: ROLE-PLAYER — 1 damage to each opponent whenever you cast a spell from outside your hand, plus energy-fuelled impulse draw; Gwen's exile plays trigger it. Cut: Torbran.

Bouncer's Beatdown.text: UPGRADE — Instant: damage equal to your greatest power (Samut makes that huge) to a creature or planeswalker, exiling it if it would die. Cut: UNOWNED: Hulk's Thunderclap (a sorcery bite).

Hydra's Growth.text: FLAVOUR — An Aura that doubles the creature's +1/+1 counters every upkeep; a fast-growing threat for Samut. Cut: UNOWNED: Gamma Grotesque (a counters card in a power deck).

Kami of Whispered Hopes.text: SIDEGRADE — Taps for mana equal to its power (Samut's +X/+0 counts) and adds an extra counter whenever counters go on. Cut: UNOWNED: Back-Alley Gardener (land ramp off creatures entering).

Narfi, Betrayer King.text: SIDEGRADE — Other Zombies get +1/+1, and the deck runs 22 Zombies. (Its snow recursion is dead here.) Cut: UNOWNED: Eternal Skylord (also a 5-drop; flying for Zombie tokens instead of +1/+1 for all Zombies).

Sidisi, Undead Vizier.text: UPGRADE — A Zombie with deathtouch; exploit (sacrifice a creature, e.g. a token) to tutor any card. Cut: UNOWNED: Fallen Shinobi (5-drop needing an unblocked attacker).

Umbral Juke.text: 91 Scarab's Fist: SIDEGRADE — Instant: target player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker, or make a 2/1 flier. Cut: UNOWNED: Never // Return (sorcery destroy, Zombie later). | 100 Resistance Is Futile: SIDEGRADE — Instant edict (creature or planeswalker), or a 2/1 flier. Cut: UNOWNED: Sheoldred's Edict (2-mana instant edict).

Warren Soultrader.text: FLAVOUR — Pay 1 life, sacrifice another creature: a Treasure. A Zombie Wizard sacrifice outlet. Cut: as above.

The Wrath of Khan.text: UPGRADE — 3-mana Saga: 4 damage to a creature, then you take control of it for combat; later chapters add value. Cut: UNOWNED: Overwhelming Victory (5-mana instant, 5 damage).

Emperor of Bones.text: UPGRADE — Exiles a card from a graveyard each combat; adapt {1}{B} brings an exiled creature back hasty for the turn, and every extra combat is another exile. Cut: UNOWNED: Archpriest of Shadows (5-mana reanimation that needs combat damage first).

Witch-king of Angmar.text: ROLE-PLAYER — 5-mana flier; when creatures hit you, the opponent sacrifices one of them; discard a card for indestructible. Cut: UNOWNED: Yathan Tombguard (draws only off creatures with counters, which the deck rarely makes).

Switchgrass Grazer.text: ROLE-PLAYER — Haste; 1 damage to any target whenever it attacks, which Isshin doubles. Cut: no unowned card it clearly beats (Nadier's Nightblade and Professional Face-Breaker both fit better).

Shapers of Nature.text: UPGRADE — A Merfolk that puts +1/+1 counters ({3}{G}) and turns a counter into a card ({2}{U}); Zimone doubles counters. Cut: UNOWNED: Nadir Kraken (not a Merfolk; also its stored printing is flagged unverified).

Emergent Sequence.text: SIDEGRADE — Fetch a basic; it becomes a land creature with +1/+1 counters, which Zimone then doubles. Cut: UNOWNED: Song of Freyalise (two turns of creature mana, then a counter each).

Ghost of Illyria.text: ROLE-PLAYER — Flier that blinks your own nonland permanent until end step; a second Galadriel entry. Cut: Panharmonicon.

Tamiyo, Compleated Sage.text: SIDEGRADE — +1 locks down a creature; −X copies a permanent card from your graveyard (thin in an opponent-mill deck). A walker to hold the board. Cut: UNOWNED: Nissa, Voice of Zendikar (also a non-mill walker).

Garruk, Cursed Huntsman.text: SPICE — 6-mana walker: two 2/2 Wolves each turn, or −3 destroy a creature and draw. Cut: UNOWNED: Ob Nixilis Reignited (a stand-in; Ob's +1 draw is a mill under the Tutelages, so Ob stays the better card).

Mesmeric Orb.text: FLAVOUR — Every untap mills that permanent's controller: the opponent untaps more, but it is symmetric. Cut: Lithoform Engine.

Sweet Oblivion.text: ROLE-PLAYER — {1}{U}: target player (the opponent) mills four; escape recasts it. On plan. Cut: no unowned card it clearly beats (Master's Councillors and Cut Your Losses both mill harder).

Feasting Troll King.text: UPGRADE — Three Foods when cast from hand; returns from the graveyard by sacrificing three Foods. {G}{G}{G}{G}. Cut: Mythweaver Poq.

Meriadoc Brandybuck.text: ROLE-PLAYER — A Food whenever your Halflings attack; the deck runs 6 Halflings. Cut: Mythweaver Poq.

Siege-Gang Commander.text: ROLE-PLAYER — Three Goblin tokens (Peregrin Took adds a Food to each); sacrifice a Goblin for 2 damage. Cut: Mythweaver Poq.

Dramatic Accusation.text: SIDEGRADE — 3-mana Aura: tap the creature and keep it tapped; {U}{U} shuffles it away. A noncreature spell for G'raha. Cut: UNOWNED: Lawmage's Binding (flash, also stops activated abilities).

Unable to Scream.text: SIDEGRADE — 1-mana Aura: the creature loses all abilities and becomes a 0/2. A cheap noncreature spell for G'raha. Cut: UNOWNED: Mesmerizing Dose (3 mana; its proliferate also grows Hero tokens).

Assembly Specialist.text: UPGRADE — 2 mana for two Borg artifact creatures, feeding Collation Trimatrix's tap-three draw and Borg Cube's affinity. Cut: UNOWNED: Tidus, Blitzball Star (not an artifact creature, so it feeds none of the deck's counts).

Bronze Walrus.text: UPGRADE — A 3-mana artifact CREATURE that taps for any colour and scries 2; it counts for Borg Cube and Collation Trimatrix. Cut: UNOWNED: Arcane Signet (a rock that counts for neither).

Class-F Shuttlecraft.text: ROLE-PLAYER — A 3-mana Spacecraft that taps for any colour; stationed to 6 it is a flying artifact creature. Cut: UNOWNED: Arcane Signet, if Bronze Walrus is not taken.

Free Borg Revolutionaries.text: ROLE-PLAYER — A Borg artifact creature that pumps the team on entering; basic landcycling {2} early. Cut: no unowned card it clearly beats; Winter at most.

Jin-Gitaxias, Progress Tyrant.text: ROLE-PLAYER — 7 mana: copies your first artifact, instant or sorcery each turn, and counters the opponent's first. Top-heavy. Cut: UNOWNED: Kappa Cannoneer (another 6-mana blue artifact payoff).

Machinist's Dismissal.text: SIDEGRADE — Counter a noncreature spell, {1} cheaper per artifact you control or hold; instant-speed interaction the deck lacks. Cut: UNOWNED: Haunt the Network (same 5 mana; a sorcery drain where this is instant interaction).

Squadron Carrier.text: ROLE-PLAYER — Spacecraft gain "exhaust {W}: conjure a Starfighter Pilot"; stationed 10+, your creatures fly. Cut: Sheoldred's Edict.

Vexing Drone.text: ROLE-PLAYER — A 2-mana Borg artifact creature that taps a blocker on entering. Cut: UNOWNED: Winter, Cursed Rider (not an artifact creature).
